who_may_join.text: Eligible participants are cancer survivors or their romantic partners, and they must be at least 18 and less than 90 years old.

procedures_or_participation.text: Participants will be approached by a PERT team member to give consent. They will be randomized to either standard care or a new test. If they choose the new test, they will provide stool samples and complete questionnaires.
